# `harness/tests/*` (the vendored harness method library) from the project
# root. Without this, `pytest` invoked bare from `/Users/johnny/projects/taskq-new`

# times out (pytest-cov at 120s) or fails collection (pytest-benchmark trips
# on a harness test referencing fixtures that do not exist in this layout).
#
# See harness/core/quality_gate/cross_artifact.py:481 and the tool_runners
# pytest invocation paths for why this matters at the gate level.
#
# `[tool.coverage.run]` scopes coverage measurement to the project's own
# source tree. The harness invokes `pytest --cov=.` from the project root
# (harness/core/quality_gate/cross_artifact.py:481); without a `source`
# constraint that would measure everything under `.` — including the
# vendored harness/, all of `.methodology/`, etc. — and blow past the
# 120s budget on a 1000+ file tree. With `source = ["03-development/src"]`
